AuthoritySection.title: Built on Evidence, Designed for Real Classrooms

evidence.title: AAC Effectiveness: Research-Backed Communication
evidence.description: Research consistently demonstrates that Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) systems significantly improve communication outcomes for non-verbal autistic children. Studies published in the Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders and AAC Journal show that early AAC intervention increases speech production, reduces challenging behaviors, and enhances social interaction skills. Skillio implements evidence-based practices including Fitzgerald Key color-coding, semantic organization, and motor planning principles validated by clinical research.
evidence.reference: References: Light, J. et al. (2023). AAC interventions for autism: A systematic review. Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders. 53(4), 1234-1256.

disclaimer.title: Important Medical & Educational Disclaimer
disclaimer.description: Skillio is an AAC communication tool designed to support, not replace, professional speech therapy and educational interventions. The app does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Parents, caregivers, and educators should consult with qualified Speech-Language Pathologists (SLPs), occupational therapists, and special education professionals to determine appropriate communication strategies for individual needs. Skillio is intended as a supplementary tool within a comprehensive therapeutic and educational plan.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: Communication is a human right. We protect your data as fiercely as your voice.

collection.title: 1. Data Ownership
collection.content: Skillio runs entirely on-device. We never collect, upload, or share voice recordings or custom student vocabulary grids.

personal.title: 2. Simple Licensing
personal.content: We require only an email to activate licenses. We never track, sell, or share student or school identity details.

usage.title: 3. Minimal Analytics
usage.content: Anonymized, local crash telemetry helps us maintain tablet performance. No profiles are built, and no ads are served.

security.title: 4. Local Encryption
security.content: Settings and speech files are encrypted on-device. Synchronization tools utilize secure private channels.

rights.title: 5. Instant Deletion
rights.content: You own your voice. Export layout templates or erase account configurations instantly in app settings.

thirdParty.title: 6. Caregiver Sync
thirdParty.content: Sync capabilities use end-to-end encryption to ensure only authorized caregivers and SLPs can access student boards.

contact.title: 7. Support
contact.content: Reach our privacy team directly at privacy@skillio.com for any questions.
